encoding.payload: u16be field count; fields in declared order, tag u16be (1-based), length u32be, payload; null payload=00; present=01||typed value
encoding.integers: fixed-width big-endian; unsigned u16/u32/u64; i64 two-complement; checked range, overflow rejects
encoding.utf8_nfc: strict UTF8 already NFC; no normalization; reject NUL/control, empty identity or >4096 bytes
encoding.array: u32be count, then u32be byte length + canonical typed element; ordered input preserves order; set sorted unsigned bytes and duplicates reject

encoding.invalid: Unknown/reordered/duplicate/missing tags, unexpected NULL, noncanonical bytes, truncated/trailing bytes, unknown versions/types reject before effect
encoding.signature: Ed25519 over complete frame excluding signature64; statically assigned sender public key from enrolled credential manifest; no algorithm/key selector
encoding.domain: FLOOOW/B01/R5/TEST; signatures also bind message type, sender, recipient and qualification tuple; never canonical attestation authority

stores.CAS_predicate: Exclusive writer; expected global revision/tip == verified durable global tip AND expected entity revision/prior record == independently reconstructed latest record for entity_key_digest AND requested phase edge legal. New operation_id never resets existing entity. Consume exact request idempotency key; append global+1/entity+1 checked; any conflict denies without replacement
stores.append_update: Append only. No in-place rewrite/truncate/delete. Logical state changes append predecessor-bound new revision; terminal keys cannot reactivate
stores.record_envelope: u32be record size || canonical signed frame || SHA256(frame), no trailing bytes; writer signature binds store_id/type and full context
stores.atomicity: Dedicated single writer per store, exclusive OS lock; before receipt append entire record, fsync ledger then fsync parent directory for creation/rotation. Startup scans complete length+signature+hash+revision chain; partial tail or ambiguous durability quarantines store and records UNKNOWN externally; never truncate into inferred abort
stores.durability: Receipt only after full fsync success and independent observer reread of identical durable tip; fsync error/lost ACK => UNKNOWN. No network/distributed filesystem assumption; future filesystem crash behavior must be qualified
stores.replay: Same operation identity key and exact canonical digest returns original signed receipt without append/effect; different digest conflicts; different operation targeting same entity must satisfy existing entity CAS/phase, never create fresh eligibility; pending never re-executes
stores.corruption: Invalid signature/hash/length/revision/tip/missing predecessor or duplicated key => store quarantined; no repair/zero/default state
stores.UNKNOWN: Persist pending on separate independently durable reservation/outcome lineage; block new work, generation and reseal until independent resolution
